verdict.rationale: Attio's marketing pages describe in-product AI that turns workspace data into insights and suggestions. 'Ask Attio' answers questions with live data from pipeline conversations. AI also flags buying signals and blockers during calls, creates account briefs, scores leads against ICP criteria, flags coaching moments in rep calls, and surfaces next-best customers. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of how these AI insight features work (all evidence is marketing copy), and independent or hands-on corroboration of insight quality.
